about: SharpTrader's tools as its AI agents server lists them, shown by the bridge while SharpTrader cannot be reached. Generated from SharpTrader's tool definitions - do not edit by hand.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.title: Overview
tools.description: Program version, local time, which tool groups are allowed, and a short status of every session and strategy.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions
tools.description: Every broker/exchange session as in the Sessions window: connection types and status of the quote and trading connection, ping, equity, balance, gain since the initial equity, open orders, average execution time and slippage.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.title: List strategies
tools.description: Every strategy as in the Strategies window: id, label, type, status (Running/Stopped), trading enabled, sessions, error counter, open orders, PnL and equity manager values.

tools.name: get_strategy_settings
tools.title: Strategy settings
tools.description: The general settings of one strategy (its window's Settings tab), each with its type, current value, allowed values and whether it may change while the strategy runs; custom bot strategies also list the bot parameters. Instrument settings: get_strategy_instruments.

tools.name: get_strategy_instruments
tools.title: Strategy instruments
tools.description: The instruments of one strategy, as its Instruments & Orders grid: every row (index, symbol) with its settings, the option groups inside it (e.g. trailing options, spread control) and its item lists (e.g. OC layers). Field types, allowed values and what may change while the strategy runs are listed once per list. Strategies with more than one list (e.g. trading intervals, filters) show them all unless collection is given.

instrument.description: Only this row: index, symbol (e.g. EURUSD) or label

live.description: Also the current values the grid shows (diffs, spreads, prices); default false

tools.name: get_performance
tools.title: Performance
tools.description: Trading statistics from the closed orders in the database, as in the Performance tab: trades, wins/losses (net of commission), net profit, profit factor, max drawdown, buy/sell split, execution time and slippage, and a per-symbol split. Filter by strategy and/or session; period or from/to selects the close time.

period.description: Close time period (ignored when from is given)

from.description: Start time, e.g. 2026-11-05 or 2026-11-05T08:00:00 (local time unless an offset is given)

tools.name: get_orders
tools.title: Orders
tools.description: Orders held by the sessions now, as in the Orders tab: open positions/orders, closed in this run, rejected, or pending (sent, waiting for the broker). Newest first. Older closed orders: get_order_history.

symbol.description: Symbol filter (as the broker names it)

tools.name: get_order_history
tools.title: Order history
tools.description: Closed orders of the strategies from the database, newest close first.

from.description: Start time, e.g. 2026-11-05 or 2026-11-05T08:00:00 (local time unless an offset is given)

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.title: Indicators
tools.description: The technical indicators get_indicator_values calculates - the ones SharpTrader's custom strategies use (Skender.Stock.Indicators) - with their parameters, defaults and choices. Without indicator: all of them in short; with indicator: that one in full.

indicator.description: One indicator, e.g. RSI or BollingerBands

tools.name: get_indicator_values
tools.title: Indicator values
tools.description: Values of a technical indicator on a session's candles, newest bar first, each with its bar's start time and close; the newest bar may still be forming. Calculated as custom strategies get them, from the candles SharpTrader collects for the symbol and timeframe. Warnings say when candle collection is off for that timeframe, when there are no or not enough candles, or when the quotes connection is down. Parameters by name as list_indicators shows them; the ones left out take their defaults.

symbol.description: Symbol as the session names it

indicator.description: Indicator name from list_indicators, e.g. SMA, RSI, MACD

count.description: How many of the newest values (default 10)

tools.name: get_strategy_log
tools.title: Strategy log
tools.description: Log lines of a strategy, newest first. Recent lines come from memory; give from/to to include lines archived in the database.

contains.description: Return only lines containing this text (case-insensitive)

from.description: Start time, e.g. 2026-11-05 or 2026-11-05T08:00:00 (local time unless an offset is given)

tools.name: get_session_log
tools.title: Session log
tools.description: Connection log of a session (quotes or trading connection), newest first. Give from/to to include lines archived in the database.

contains.description: Return only lines containing this text (case-insensitive)

from.description: Start time, e.g. 2026-11-05 or 2026-11-05T08:00:00 (local time unless an offset is given)

tools.name: get_journal
tools.title: Journal
tools.description: SharpTrader's journal (program events, errors, MCP calls), newest first.

contains.description: Return only lines containing this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: get_news
tools.title: News filter
tools.description: The News tab: this week's economic calendar events (Forex Factory) and the tab's options. An enabled event is in its window from 'before' ahead of its time until 'after' past it, for the symbols whose name contains its currency (ALL: every symbol). Strategies with the news filter on (setting UseNewsFilter, 'Check news filter') and NewsAction 1 ('don't trade on news') open no trades in that window; NewsAction 0 ('trade on news') trades only in it - change both with update_strategy_settings. Also lists the strategies that use the filter and the events in their window now. index is the event's number for update_news_events.

upcoming_only.description: Only events that are not over yet (default false)

tools.name: start_strategy
tools.title: Start strategy
tools.description: Starts a stopped strategy (the Start button). It trades only while 'trading enabled' is on and its sessions are connected.

tools.name: stop_strategy
tools.title: Stop strategy
tools.description: Stops a running strategy (the Stop button). Open positions stay open but are no longer managed by the strategy until it starts again.

tools.name: start_all_strategies
tools.title: Start all strategies
tools.description: Starts every stopped strategy.

tools.name: stop_all_strategies
tools.title: Stop all strategies
tools.description: Stops every running strategy. Open positions stay open but unmanaged.

tools.name: set_strategy_trading
tools.title: Enable/disable trading
tools.description: Turns the strategy's 'Trading' switch (Strategies window) on or off. Off: the strategy keeps running but opens no new trades.

tools.name: connect_session
tools.title: Connect session
tools.description: Connects a session's quote and trading connections (the Connect button). Connecting continues in the background; wait_seconds waits for the result.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for CONNECTED (default 0)

tools.name: disconnect_session
tools.title: Disconnect session
tools.description: Disconnects a session (the Disconnect button). Running strategies on it stop trading on it.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for DISCONNECTED (default 0)

tools.name: connect_all_sessions
tools.title: Connect all sessions
tools.description: Connects every session that is not connected (Ctrl+Connect).

tools.name: disconnect_all_sessions
tools.title: Disconnect all sessions
tools.description: Disconnects every session (Ctrl+Disconnect).

tools.name: update_strategy_settings
tools.title: Change strategy settings
tools.description: Changes general strategy settings and saves the strategy. general = {settingName: value}; botParameters = {name: value} for custom bot strategies. Names and what may change while running come from get_strategy_settings; instrument settings are changed with update_strategy_instruments. All changes are checked first: if one is wrong nothing changes. Refused while the strategy's window is open in SharpTrader.

botParameters.description: Custom bot strategies only: bot parameters to change (strategy stopped)

tools.name: update_strategy_instruments
tools.title: Change instrument settings
tools.description: Changes instrument settings (the Instruments & Orders grid and its option dialogs) and saves the strategy. changes = [{instrument, values, collection?}]: instrument = row index, symbol, label or "*" for every row; values = {field: value}, option groups as {"trailingOptions1": {"StopLoss": 50}} or "trailingOptions1.StopLoss", list items as "lstOCLayers[0].OpenDiff". collection is needed only when the strategy has several instrument lists. Numbers, check boxes and choices may change while the strategy runs; texts need it stopped; symbol names need it stopped with no open orders (when changing a symbol, also set its Digits/lot fields). Instruments cannot be added or removed. All changes are checked first: if one is wrong nothing changes. Refused while the strategy's window is open in SharpTrader.

instrument.description: Row index, symbol (e.g. EURUSD), label, or * for every row

collection.description: List name, e.g. lstInstruments (only when there are several)

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.title: Create strategy
tools.description: Adds a new strategy of the given type, as the Strategies window's Add strategy button, but applies no symbol template and opens no window. It is saved and stopped. It has no sessions and usually no instruments: the user sets them in its window in SharpTrader (these tools cannot add sessions or instruments) - to get a ready strategy, clone a configured one instead. Only the types in the licence are allowed (get_overview: creatableStrategyTypes).

label.description: Label of the new strategy: unique, up to 64 letters, digits, spaces and _ - . ( ) # (default: the type and a unique number)

single_session.description: Both legs on one session (the dialog's Single session box): only Lock, LockCL, LockCL2, LockCL3, Statistical, Triangular; default false

tools.name: clone_strategy
tools.title: Clone strategy
tools.description: Copies a strategy with its settings, instruments and sessions, as the clone button in the Strategies window, and saves the copy. The copy is stopped, has no orders and keeps the original's trading enabled and autorun values. Change it with update_strategy_settings / update_strategy_instruments.

label.description: Label of the new strategy: unique, up to 64 letters, digits, spaces and _ - . ( ) # (default: the original's label + _cloned)

tools.name: refresh_news
tools.title: Refresh news calendar
tools.description: Downloads this week's calendar from Forex Factory (the News tab's Refresh button) and keeps the events that pass the tab's filters (update_news_settings), all enabled and for ALL symbols. apply (default true) then presses Apply changes: the new list replaces the one strategies use and is saved, so earlier changes to events are lost. apply=false leaves the new list in the tab for the user to check; the old list stays in effect until Apply changes. After this call each event's own currency is known (update_news_events currency "own").

apply.description: Put the new list in effect (Apply changes); default true

tools.name: update_news_settings
tools.title: Change news options
tools.description: Changes the News tab's options and presses Apply changes (saved). before/after and their units set the window around each event and take effect at once. The filters (symbols, ignore words, impacts, current day only) decide which events refresh_news keeps; the current list is not filtered again. Give only what changes. Apply changes also applies what the user changed in the tab and did not apply yet.

symbols_filter_enabled.description: Symbols filter: keep only the events of these currencies

ignore_filter_enabled.description: Ignore filter: drop the events whose title or impact contains one of these words

show_only_current_day.description: Keep only the events of the day of the refresh

before.description: Window before an event's time, in before_unit

after.description: Window after an event's time, in after_unit

tools.name: update_news_events
tools.title: Change news events
tools.description: Turns events on or off and sets which symbols they affect (the News tab's Enabled and Currency columns), then presses Apply changes (saved). changes = [{event, impact?, enabled?, currency?}]: event = index (get_news), "*" for every event, or a text the title contains (every match, case-insensitive); impact narrows it to High, Medium, Low or Holiday events. currency = ALL (every symbol), a code the symbol names contain (USD affects EURUSD and USDJPY), or "own" for the event's own currency (known after refresh_news). Changes apply in order; all are checked first and if one is wrong nothing changes. Apply changes also puts a refreshed list that was not applied yet in effect. SharpTrader sets every event's currency back to ALL when it starts.

event.description: Index (get_news), * for every event, or a text the title contains

enabled.description: true = the event is checked by the news filter

currency.description: ALL, a currency code such as USD, or own

tools.name: close_strategy_positions
tools.title: Close strategy positions
tools.description: Closes all positions of a running strategy at market (its Close All button). The orders are sent at once and close in the background; get_orders state=open shows what is left.
